input.command:
python -c "exec("""import duckdb, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from pathlib import Path
out=Path('out'); out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
df=duckdb.query("""select extract(year from crash_date)::int as year, sum(number_of_pedestrians_killed)::int as pedestrians_killed from read_parquet('data/crashes.parquet') where crash_date >= date '2013-01-01' and crash_date < date '2026-01-01' group by year order by year""").df()
df.to_csv(out/'values_1.csv', index=False); df.to_csv(out/'values_2.csv', index=False)
years=df['year']; vals=df['pedestrians_killed']
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(10,5.5)); bars=ax.bar(years,vals,color='#3b82a0',width=.72); ax.bar_label(bars,padding=3,fontsize=8); ax.set(title='Pedestrians killed in NYC motor vehicle crashes by year',xlabel='Crash year',ylabel='Pedestrians killed'); ax.set_xticks(years); ax.set_ylim(0,max(vals)*1.15); ax.grid(axis='y',alpha=.25); fig.tight_layout(); fig.savefig(out/'option_1.png',dpi=160); plt.close(fig)
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(10,5.5)); ax.plot(years,vals,color='#c45a3c',marker='o',linewidth=2);
for x,y in zip(years,vals): ax.annotate(str(y),(x,y),xytext=(0,7),textcoords='offset points',ha='center',fontsize=8)
ax.set(title='Annual trend in pedestrians killed in NYC motor vehicle crashes',xlabel='Crash year',ylabel='Pedestrians killed'); ax.set_xticks(years); ax.set_ylim(0,max(vals)*1.15); ax.grid(axis='y',alpha=.25); fig.tight_layout(); fig.savefig(out/'option_2.png',dpi=160); plt.close(fig)
print(df.to_string(index=False))
""")"

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(10,5.5)); ax.plot(years,vals,color="#c45a3c",marker="o",linewidth=2)
for x,y in zip(years,vals): ax.annotate(str(y),(x,y),xytext=(0,7),textcoords="offset points",ha="center",fontsize=8)
ax.set(title="Annual trend in pedestrians killed in NYC motor vehicle crashes",xlabel="Crash year",ylabel="Pedestrians killed"); ax.set_xticks(years); ax.set_ylim(0,max(vals)*1.15); ax.grid(axis="y",alpha=.25); fig.tight_layout(); fig.savefig(out/"option_2.png",dpi=160); plt.close(fig)
print(df.to_string(index=False))'
